BLOCKED: two compiler defects stop the properties step, and nothing is committed or pushed. Report: /home/user/Nikaia/docs/briefs/yaml/y2c-properties.md.report.md

The pre-flight passed: #1026's probe prints `12 34 12 34`. The draft from `wip/y2-properties` applied cleanly onto develop, but the compiler refuses it:

1. **A function called from a grammar guard is not seen as called from there.** The text-tier pass ignores the call in `if(fits(s), ..)`. Once `is_float` also has an ordinary caller, its `String` parameter is treated as an owned copy, and the line `s.strip_prefix("-") ?? s` is refused with NK1185. The same call made inside the rule's action passes. Probe: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Nikaia/d670a077-08ea-472f-938c-ddf2b0227c58/scratchpad/y2c/p4/main.nika
2. **A guard cannot read a text label that has a binding inside it**, as in `s:text(d:Ch+) if(s.len() > 1, ..)`. The generated Rust only defines `s` inside the action, after the guard has run, so rustc says `cannot find value s`. The draft's double-quoted scalar rule needs this. Probe: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Nikaia/d670a077-08ea-472f-938c-ddf2b0227c58/scratchpad/y2c/p6/main.nika

To get past the first defect I disabled the one call in a scratch copy. That copy passes the check, then all 10 package tests fail in rustc on the second defect. Any further defects are hidden behind these two.

The brief doesn't allow changes outside `packages/yaml/`, so I didn't fix either one. Each needs a `ready` issue and a compiler fix: the first in `text_tiers.nika`, the second in the grammar code generator. After that this brief can run again from the same draft, which is unchanged on `wip/y2-properties`. I put back my working copy of `packages/yaml/src/main.nika`, so the tree is clean.

Disk: the test cache `target/nikaia-project-tests` is 5.9 GB, 11 GB is free on `/`, and this run created no cache entry over 100 MB.
